title: About tool-chest
subtitle: Privacy-first utility toolbox for everyday tasks.
intro: tool-chest delivers fast, client-side tools so your data stays on your device. No accounts, no tracking, and a strong focus on accessibility.

privacy.title: Privacy-first
privacy.description: Most tools run entirely in your browser, keeping sensitive data local.

accessibility.title: Accessible by default
accessibility.description: Built to meet WCAG 2.1 AA with keyboard-friendly flows and clear focus states.

reliability.title: Reliable and fast
reliability.description: Modern Next.js architecture, offline-friendly patterns, and zero-cost usage.
